flawless: My strength is my army's strength, and my army never broke a sweat.
Keld takes what it wants. Today it wanted your pride, and took it whole.
solid: Hah! Good! A Keldon warlord is measured by the scars he collects.
You cut down some of my warriors. The rest crushed you. That is war.
close: Most of my warband is gone and my sword arm is numb. Glorious!
One warrior left at my side and still I won. Sing of that, outsider.
